name: 八字刘海锁骨内扣发
promptEn: Natural dark brown collarbone-length hair, center-parted curtain bangs opening into an inverted V and blending into cheek-framing side layers, smooth mostly straight lengths with subtle low layers and softly inward-curled ends, moderate natural volume and realistic individual strands.
promptZh: 自然深棕色锁骨发，中分八字刘海向两侧展开，与修饰脸颊的侧边层次自然衔接；主体顺直、低层次，发尾柔和内扣，发量适中，发丝质感真实自然。

name: 轻薄齐刘海齐颈波波头
promptEn: Natural black chin-to-upper-neck-length bob, wispy straight-across bangs grazing the eyebrows with small gaps between strands and slightly longer corners blending into cheek-framing side pieces, softly rounded crown and ears mostly covered, smooth mostly straight lengths with subtle low layers and gently inward-curved ends, a compact rounded silhouette with airy textured tips and realistic individual strands.
promptZh: 自然黑色齐颈波波头，长度在下巴至上颈部之间；轻薄齐刘海落在眉眼之间，发束间留有自然缝隙，两侧略长并衔接修饰脸颊的侧发；头顶柔和蓬松，基本遮住耳朵，主体顺直、低层次，发尾轻微内扣，轮廓圆润紧凑，发梢轻盈有纹理，发丝质感真实自然。

name: 微厚齐刘海齐颈波波头
promptEn: Natural black chin-to-upper-neck-length bob, moderately dense straight-across bangs grazing the eyebrows, softly covering the forehead with only a few narrow strand separations and lightly textured tips, slightly longer corners blending into cheek-framing side pieces, softly rounded crown and ears mostly covered, smooth mostly straight lengths with subtle low layers and gently inward-curved ends, a compact rounded silhouette with airy textured tips and realistic individual strands.
promptZh: 自然黑色齐颈波波头，长度在下巴至上颈部之间；齐刘海落在眉眼之间，厚度适中，较轻薄款略厚，柔和覆盖额头，仅保留少量细窄发束缝隙，末端自然轻盈；两侧略长并衔接修饰脸颊的侧发，头顶柔和蓬松，基本遮住耳朵，主体顺直、低层次，发尾轻微内扣，轮廓圆润紧凑，发梢轻盈有纹理，发丝质感真实自然。

name: 齐耳短发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，耳垂长度短波波头，自然侧分长刘海，顶部圆润，后颈短净，发梢轻微内弯。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Earlobe-length short bob, natural side part and long swept fringe, rounded crown, neat short nape and subtly inward-bent tips. Realistic individual strands.

name: 下巴短发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，下巴长度齐切波波头，中分无刘海，发尾平直厚实，轮廓利落，低层次。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chin-length blunt bob, center part without bangs, straight dense ends and a crisp level perimeter with minimal layering. Realistic individual strands.

name: 层次短发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，下巴长度层次短发，顶部轻盈蓬松，侧分碎刘海，侧面与后颈逐层收短，发尾有清晰碎剪纹理。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chin-length layered short haircut with an airy lifted crown, side-parted piecey fringe, graduated shorter sides and nape, visibly feathered textured ends. Realistic individual strands.

name: 内扣短发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，下巴至上颈部短波波头，轻薄齐刘海，顺滑低层次，整圈发尾明显向内扣成C形，圆润包裹下颌。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Upper-neck-length short bob with wispy straight bangs, smooth low layers and distinct C-shaped inward-curled ends wrapping around the jaw. Realistic individual strands.

name: 短狼尾
promptZh: 自然深棕色，短狼尾发型，顶部蓬松碎层次，短碎刘海，两侧露耳，后颈保留明显较长的轻薄尾发至颈根，轮廓前短后长。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Short wolf-cut mullet with choppy voluminous crown layers, short piecey bangs, exposed ears and a visibly longer feathered nape tail reaching the neck base. Realistic individual strands.

name: 齐肩直发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，齐肩直发，中分无刘海，发尾刚好触及肩线，整体顺直低层次，齐切平直发尾。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Shoulder-length straight hair, center part without bangs, tips just touching the shoulders, smooth low layers and a flat blunt perimeter. Realistic individual strands.

name: 锁骨直发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，锁骨长度直发，中分无刘海，长度明显低于肩线，发尾平直，低层次，发量适中。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Collarbone-length straight hair clearly extending below the shoulders, center part without bangs, straight ends, low layers and moderate density. Realistic individual strands.

name: 空气刘海锁骨发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，锁骨长度顺直发，眉间轻薄空气刘海，刘海发束间透出额头，两侧自然衔接脸旁长发，发尾轻微内扣。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Collarbone-length smooth hair with airy eyebrow-length see-through bangs, fine separated fringe strands and longer face-framing sides, subtly inward-bent ends. Realistic individual strands.

name: 侧分锁骨发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，锁骨长度直发，明显三七侧分，无齐刘海，长侧发沿脸颊斜落，一侧露耳，发根自然蓬松，发尾轻微内弯。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Collarbone-length hair with a pronounced 70/30 side part and no blunt bangs, long diagonal face-framing sweep, one exposed ear, lifted roots and gently inward-bent tips. Realistic individual strands.

name: 日系层次锁骨发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，锁骨长度日系层次发，轻薄碎刘海，脸旁有颧骨至下颌的阶梯层次，顶部轻盈，外层碎发自然外翘，下层发尾略内弯。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Japanese-style collarbone-length layered haircut with wispy piecey bangs, stepped cheekbone-to-jaw face-framing layers, airy crown, feathered outward flicks over softly inward-bent lower ends. Realistic individual strands.

name: 中分长直发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，中分长直发，无刘海，发长至胸部，整体顺滑直垂，低层次，发尾呈轻微U形，适中发量。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Long straight chest-length hair with a clean center part and no bangs, sleek vertical lengths, minimal layering and a gently U-shaped perimeter. Realistic individual strands.

name: 侧分长直发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，侧分长直发，无齐刘海，明显三七分缝，长侧发斜掠额侧，发长至胸部，顺滑直垂，低层次。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Long straight chest-length hair with a pronounced 70/30 side part, no blunt bangs, long fringe sweeping diagonally past one temple, sleek low-layer lengths. Realistic individual strands.

name: 齐刘海长直发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，长直发至胸部，齐刘海平齐落在眉毛处，厚度适中、末端轻微碎剪，两侧与长直发衔接，主体顺直低层次。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length straight hair with moderately dense eyebrow-length straight-across bangs, a precise fringe line with lightly textured tips and smooth low-layer lengths. Realistic individual strands.

name: 法式卷
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度法式卷发，轻薄法式刘海，颧骨以下松散不规则S卷，卷束方向交错，发根自然蓬松，复古随性。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length French waves with wispy parted French bangs, loose irregular S-curls starting below the cheekbones, alternating curl directions and naturally airy roots. Realistic individual strands.

name: 慵懒卷
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度慵懒卷，中分无刘海，发根到下颌基本顺直，下颌以下稀疏柔和松卷，卷度松散自然，整体蓬松适中。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length relaxed loose waves, center part without bangs, mostly straight from roots to jaw, a few soft widely spaced curls below the jaw and moderate natural volume. Realistic individual strands.

name: 自然大弧度卷
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度自然大弧度卷，侧分，发根平顺，从肩部开始形成少量宽大柔和C形和S形弧度，发尾向外松散卷曲，光泽自然。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length natural large-bend hair with a side part, smooth roots and a few broad soft C and S bends beginning at the shoulders, gently rolled-out ends. Realistic individual strands.

name: 高层次卷发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度高层次卷发，中分长八字刘海，颧骨到下颌有明显短层次，卷曲层叠向外翻，顶部蓬松，长发底部较轻薄，蝶形轮廓。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length high-layered curly haircut with center-parted long curtain bangs, distinct short cheekbone-to-jaw layers, stacked outward curls, lifted crown and a light tapered butterfly silhouette. Realistic individual strands.

name: 水波纹
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度水波纹长发，中分无刘海，从耳旁至发尾排列整齐连续的中等S形波纹，波峰间距均匀，光滑有光泽，贴顺的波浪轮廓。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length water-wave hair, center part without bangs, regular continuous medium S-shaped waves from ear level to the ends, evenly spaced glossy wave ridges and a smooth coherent silhouette. Realistic individual strands.

name: 木马卷
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度木马卷，中分长八字刘海，颅顶抬高，从颧骨附近起卷，立体蓬松的中大卷交错堆叠，卷束清晰，发尾饱满，横向轮廓有体积。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length voluminous carousel curls with center-parted long curtain bangs, lifted crown, clearly defined medium-large interlocking curls starting near the cheekbones, full ends and rounded three-dimensional volume. Realistic individual strands.

name: 羊毛卷
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度羊毛卷，发根附近即起密集细小螺旋卷，额前也有细卷刘海，整头卷度细密均匀，横向蓬松发量感强，发尾保留小卷。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length wool curls with dense small tight spiral ringlets beginning near the roots, small curly bangs, uniform fine coils throughout and a wide fluffy high-volume silhouette. Realistic individual strands.

name: 芭比卷
promptZh: 自然深棕色，胸部长度芭比卷，轻薄卷刘海，从头部上半段开始排列柔和中小螺旋卷，卷束圆润、规整而有弹性，比羊毛卷更大更松，蓬松甜美。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Chest-length Barbie curls with light curled bangs, soft bouncy medium-small spiral ringlets starting in the upper lengths, rounded orderly curl clumps visibly larger and looser than tight wool curls. Realistic individual strands.

name: 圆寸
promptZh: 自然深棕色，男士圆寸，整头均匀约6毫米极短发，顺着自然头型呈圆弧，发际线清晰，露出额头与双耳，无长刘海，无平顶。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Men's uniform buzz cut about 6 mm long over the whole head, following the rounded skull, clean natural hairline, exposed forehead and ears, no fringe and no flat top. Realistic individual strands.

name: 板寸
promptZh: 自然深棕色，男士板寸，顶部短发约1.5厘米，直立修成明显水平平面，方正利落的顶部轮廓，两侧和后颈推短渐变，额头完全露出。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Men's short flat-top crew cut with upright hair about 1.5 cm on top trimmed into a distinct horizontal plane, squared upper silhouette, tightly tapered sides and nape, fully exposed forehead. Realistic individual strands.

name: 栗子头
promptZh: 自然深棕色，男士栗子头，顶部短而圆润，约2至3厘米细碎纹理，额前短齐刘海在额头上方形成轻圆弧，两侧渐变推短，整体紧凑。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Men's chestnut crop, compact rounded 2–3 cm textured crown, very short blunt fringe high on the forehead with a gently curved edge, faded short sides and neat nape. Realistic individual strands.

name: 短碎发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，男士短碎发，顶部约3至4厘米，发束参差碎剪并轻微上提，额前刘海短而不齐、露出部分额头，两侧与后颈干净收短，发型轻盈。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Men's short textured crop with 3–4 cm choppy lifted top, short irregular separated fringe exposing part of the forehead, neat tapered sides and nape, airy piecey texture. Realistic individual strands.

name: 碎盖
promptZh: 自然深棕色，男士碎盖，头顶至额前约6至8厘米自然前落，碎刘海接近眉毛、基本覆盖额头，无明显分缝，顶部圆润，耳周两侧和后颈收短，发梢碎剪轻盈。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Men's textured covered crop with 6–8 cm forward-falling top, piecey eyebrow-grazing fringe covering most of the forehead, no defined part, rounded crown and trimmed ears and nape. Realistic individual strands.

name: 微分碎盖
promptZh: 自然深棕色，男士微分碎盖，头顶约7至9厘米，额前近中分但只露出一条窄小三角额头，刘海向两侧自然弯曲散落，其余额头仍被覆盖，蓬松碎剪、两侧与后颈收短。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Men's softly parted textured crop with 7–9 cm airy top, a subtle near-center split exposing only a narrow small forehead triangle, curved fringe falling to both sides and covering the rest of the forehead, trimmed sides and nape. Realistic individual strands.

name: 精灵短发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，女性精灵短发，侧面与后颈贴头剪短，双耳完整露出，头顶3至5厘米轻盈碎层次，额前短侧扫刘海，后颈干净，不留狼尾。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Feminine pixie haircut with closely cropped sides and nape, fully exposed ears, airy choppy 3–5 cm crown layers and a short side-swept fringe, neat nape without a mullet tail. Realistic individual strands.

name: 男孩风短发
promptZh: 自然深棕色，女性男孩风短发，中性柔和圆形轮廓，顶部约6至8厘米柔软碎层次，长短不齐的前落刘海，耳周柔和修剪，后颈自然渐短，明显长于精灵短发。发丝质感真实自然。
promptEn: Natural dark brown hair. Androgynous boyish short haircut with a soft rounded silhouette, 6–8 cm gently layered crown, piecey forward-falling fringe, soft scissor-cut sides around the ears and a tapered nape, visibly longer than a pixie. Realistic individual strands.
